question: Who was the founder of the Gurjara - Pratihara dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagabhata I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nagabhata I** was the founder of the **Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty**, which ruled parts of northern and western India.
 
• He established the dynasty in the **8th century CE** and set the foundation for a powerful empire.
